slides.sub: Frederic William Burton, The Meeting on the Turret Stairs, 1864

slides.headline: A narrow tower stair. Two lovers meet in *secret*.
He presses his lips to her arm, eyes *closed*.
She turns away and hides her face against the *wall*.
Her hand is flat on the stone, as if to stay *standing*.
Her long braid falls down her blue *gown*.
He still wears his chain-mail hood. He is her *guard*.
His helmet hangs ready. He cannot *stay*.
A sword at his side. Her brothers will not *forgive*.
One step down, and he must *go*.
The story comes from an old Danish *ballad*.
Their love is forbidden. Would you *risk* it?
